symptom: `mxcli check script.mdl -p app.mpr` on a large MPR v1 project (Evora, 140 MB) takes ~15-17 s for a one-flow `create or modify microflow`; ~9 s of it in CheckProjectConflicts, although an or-modify statement is never a same-kind conflict
cause: loadProjectNameSets listed every one of ~40 document kinds (plus every module's security, ~5 s alone) before looking at the script, and CheckProjectNameClashes did the same for its 13 kinds; checkTranslationTargets read the project settings for every script. Each listing is a full scan of the stored model on MPR v1
file: mdl/executor/validate_duplicates.go (projectNameSets.setFor now lists on first use; CheckProjectConflicts reads only kinds a plain CREATE names, drops gated on that), validate_name_clash.go (CheckProjectNameClashes lists only the name spaces a create/rename/move asks about), validate_exec_refusals.go (settings read only with a create translations), validate_duplicates_listing_test.go
insight: A check that preloads 'everything it might consult' scales with the project, not the script. The semantics-preserving rewrite is lazy-per-key plus a static pre-pass over the statements for which keys can ever be READ: mutations (drop/rename) on a key nothing reads may go to a throwaway set. Prove it with a call-counting MockBackend (reflect over the List*Func fields, fill nil ones), not a timer — on main the or-modify script issued 36 listings, after it issues the 3 of the flow name space (CE0122 microflow/nanoflow/rule clash still applies to or-modify) and 0 for a kind with no shared name space
